bio: This page contains detailed information on Strategic Brew . It includes a number of videos that illustrate the use of the simulation. You may download the user manual by clicking here . A detailed technical manual is also available upon request. If you are an instructor considering the use of Strategic Brew , you may request a courtesy copy (casadesus@gmail.com).
